description: The user's page preferences are now these: the navigation order and which pages are hidden, whether the viewport switch and the layout switch are shown, and whether the desk layout is being arranged.

nav.description: The navigation in order. Each entry names a page and whether it is hidden from the nav. Pages not listed append in pages: list order; paths no longer served are dropped by the consumers.

hidden.description: The page is hidden from the navigation (still reachable by URL).

viewportSwitchHidden.description: The Desk|Phone viewport switch is hidden.

layoutSwitchHidden.description: The layout switch is hidden; while hidden the desk is not arrangeable.

arranging.description: The desk layout is being arranged: the arrange controls are shown.
